Container.Name: Cove-VAAPI
Container.Overview: Cove is a local media organizer for videos, images, galleries, audio, and text. This VAAPI template runs ghcr.io/yourcove/cove-app with Intel or AMD GPU transcoding via /dev/dri.[br][br]This container needs PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector running separately. Point the connection string at that database before starting Cove. On a custom Docker network, set Host to the PostgreSQL container name. On the default bridge network, set Host to your Unraid server IP and publish PostgreSQL port 5432.[br][br]After the container starts, open the WebUI and complete first-run setup. Add /media as a library path inside Cove. Do not expose the WebUI to the internet until you have created the owner account.[br][br]Keep appdata on a cache pool. The app runs as uid 1000; if startup reports it cannot write to /config, run chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/cove from the Unraid terminal.[br][br]Leave the VAAPI Device mapping at /dev/dri. Hardware acceleration defaults to vaapi; switch it to qsv in Cove Settings - Transcoding for Intel Quick Sync. For NVIDIA GPUs, use Cove-NVIDIA. For CPU-only hosts, use Cove-CPU.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Cove configuration, installed extensions, and logs

Config.Name: Generated Assets
Config.Description: Covers, thumbnails, previews, and other derived assets. Can grow large; move to a share if needed.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Automatic database backups created before migrations

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Host path to your media library. Add /media as a library path in Cove. Change to read-only to prevent source deletion and extension-provided rename operations. Add more Path mappings for additional shares.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Connection String
Config.Description: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector. On a custom docker network, Host is the database container name. On bridge, set Host to your Unraid server IP.

Config.Name: VAAPI Device
Config.Description: Intel or AMD GPU device. Do not remove or leave empty; Docker rejects --device=''.

Config.Name: Hardware Acceleration
Config.Description: vaapi for Intel/AMD. Use qsv instead for Intel Quick Sync. Confirm the same value in Cove Settings - Transcoding.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Reserved for managed PostgreSQL data. Unused with the external database in this template.

Config.Name: Managed PostgreSQL
Config.Description: Must stay false. This image uses the external PostgreSQL connection string.
